description: This file implements the advanced interface functions of the Bwrm Env Controller Object, handling cache management, page retrieval, and cache control for the Broadway Web Resource Manager.

methods.name: BwrmEcoRamGetCacheNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache entry count from the page manager.

methods.name: BwrmEcoRamSetCacheNumber
methods.description: Sets the cache entry count in the page manager.

methods.name: BwrmEcoRamControlCache
methods.description: Controls cache activity such as enable, disable, or reset based on control code.

methods.name: BwrmEcoRamGetRawPage
methods.description: Retrieves raw page data from file based on root and page path.

methods.name: BwrmEcoRamGetCookedPage
methods.description: Retrieves a cooked page object from cache.

methods.name: BwrmEcoRamAddCookedPage
methods.description: Adds a cooked page object into the cache.

methods.name: BwrmEcoRamDelCookedPage
methods.description: Deletes a cooked page object from cache.

methods.name: BwrmEcoRamIsPageCachedForced
methods.description: Checks if a specific page is marked to be forcibly cached.

methods.name: BwrmEcoRamForcePageCache
methods.description: Forces or unforces caching of a specific page.
